svg.title: Baggage handler — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as baggage handler, wearing a safety vest and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Two handled suitcases of different heights rest on a low luggage trolley with two separate wheels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
